name: Ayakashidani Ninpouchou
source:
Before you a mysterious Ninja girl suddenly falls out of the sky!
Is it a maid!? Is it a magical girl!? Or perhaps a expert hitman!!!??
No, it's Yato, the Kunoichi (Ninja girl) and she's hot on the tail of some
runaway Ninjas who have broken their Ninja code and fled the commune!

She is from the Ninja village of Ayakashidani, and a battle pertaining to the
legendary Ninja "Transformation Spell" is about to spill out before your eyes.
Cum, love juices, blood and more blood.
A battle of blood and cum and love juice and blood and Ninja spells
like a powder-keg just waiting to explode before your eyes!

In the end, who will come out on top!? To become the new ruler of the shadows!?
